agent_vs_you: The agent's plan is what I would want: one code text-overlay on the user's clip with the exact handle, and it spelled out everything in extra (at: bottom; align: right; small; opacity 70%; faint shadow; edge padding 3%). The tool silently ignored all of it but 'at: bottom': text-overlay only reads text and at, always centres the card horizontally, sizes the font to a twelfth of the short side (about 60 px on 720p), and always draws a 55% black box with no shadow. So a 'subtle bottom-right watermark' came out as a big bottom-centre label that also sits on top of the clip's own burned-in subtitles ('Right here, Vega.'). The catalogue line hints at the band ('one plain font on a band') but says 'GUARANTEES placement' and 'grows large unless the size is set', while no size can be set. With today's tools the only alternative is image (lettering) of the handle on plain black, filter look: transparent, then place at bottom-right: right corner and size, but no translucency. The real answer is a watermark mode in text-overlay.

your_plan.say: I'll put @flightschool as a small, slightly see-through white watermark with a faint shadow in the bottom-right corner, inset from the edges, for the whole clip. The footage and sound stay as they are.

params.extra: at: bottom; align: right; size: 3% of height; opacity: 0.7; shadow: soft; box: none; margin: 4%; from: 0; to: 7

steps.why: Code, 0 credits: exact handle for the whole 7 s, original frames and audio kept; needs the watermark-mode fix below (today align, size, opacity, shadow and box are ignored).

fix: Harness (text-overlay.js + captionCard): read align (left|center|right), size (px or % of height), opacity, shadow and box (none|band) from extra, with margin; add a 'watermark' preset (small, right-aligned, about 70% white, soft shadow, no box, 4% inset). Update the catalogue line: text-overlay WELL 'a small text watermark or handle in a corner (extra: align, size, opacity, shadow, box: none)', and drop 'GUARANTEES placement' until placement options exist. Have the tool report extras it cannot honour instead of returning success.
evidence: radio-lines.mp4 is 1280x720, 7.0 s with audio, and already carries its own small subtitles at bottom centre ('Right here, Vega.'). radio-lines-watermarked.mp4 (1280x720, 7.0 s, audio kept) shows '@flightschool' exact, white, about 60 px tall, centred at the bottom on a dark translucent box, fixed for the whole clip and overlapping the clip's own subtitle line. text-overlay.js uses only params.text and params.at; captionCard centres the box (bx=(W-bw)/2) and fills it at 55% black; no opacity, shadow, size or alignment option exists.
